_note: Monetary and market claims from the most recent videos, August 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: Canada, America and Mexico merge into one currency, a new dollar type currency, in a vision he dates to around 2023.
mentions.quote: I saw Canada, America, and Mexico becoming one, a one currency
mentions.falsify_match: A North American common currency or formal monetary union.

mentions.claim_text: Venezuelan and American oil stabilise the dollar, with big money flowing in the Gulf, giving America a second wind and a buffer for a season.
mentions.quote: I see Venezuela and American oil stabling the dollar
mentions.falsify_match: US-Venezuela oil expansion coinciding with dollar strength.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such oil arrangement or no dollar support from it.

mentions.claim_text: Moves around Taiwan, North Korea and Canada are all playing out because the dollar is in trouble under a forty trillion dollar debt, and a new ground zero and major shaking comes to Canada.
mentions.quote: a new ground zero would come in Canada a new major shaking
causes: dollar weakness and the debt load
mentions.falsify_match: A major crisis event in Canada tied to currency stress.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Canadian crisis of that kind.

mentions.claim_text: Canada's economy goes into trouble under fifty percent tariffs, which he ties back to an earlier vision of whisky barrels rolling out of Canada and bursting, along with a rift and another 9/11 type ground zero.
mentions.quote: Canada's economy will be in trouble

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shown the top price Bitcoin will ever reach but is withholding the number publicly.
mentions.quote: I saw exactly the top dollar of what Bitcoin will ever get to
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable while the number is withheld: no stated figure can be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail as long as the number stays private.

mentions.claim_text: A new cold war centred on Cuba, with the Ukrainian leadership described as a controlled puppet.
mentions.quote: A cold war for the puppet
mentions.falsify_match: A Cuba-centred standoff between major powers.
